bill.name: H.R. 1847 — To codify Executive Order 14158 relating to establishing and implementing the President’s Department of Government Efficiency
bill.status: Introduced in House · Issa · referred to House Oversight and Government Reform on 2025-03-05

provisions.title: Section 1
provisions.heading: Codifying Executive Order 14158 relating to establishing and implementing the President’s Department of Government Efficiency
provisions.quote: Executive Order 14158 (90 Fed. Reg. 8441; relating to establishing and implementing the President’s Department of Government Efficiency) shall have the force and effect of law.
provisions.context: Section 1 is the bill’s only substantive provision. It incorporates Executive Order 14158 as a whole by citation rather than restating or separately amending the order’s terms. The title describes the order as relating to establishing and implementing the President’s Department of Government Efficiency, but the supplied bill text does not define that entity or specify any underlying structure, duties, actors, funding, deadlines, enforcement, reporting, or outcomes. Source limit: The supplied source does not reproduce Executive Order 14158, so this extraction analyzes only the incorporation clause, identifies no forecastable performance metric or conditional forecast cell, and does not infer the order’s substantive requirements or effects.
goals: Give Executive Order 14158 the force and effect of law.
